symptom: AssertionError: selected component did not return a witness
cause: v2.run_rung passes the whole component record into compose_witness. The strict v2.1 adapter incorrectly treated that record as the selected lane result and looked for record['witness'] instead of record['selected']['witness'].
repair: Read only component_record['selected']['witness']; then remap local roots through the immutable component manifest, require disjoint complete global root coverage, and independently evaluate the union witness on the original hybrid.
